title: The Letter of Little Hawley
author: Paloma Sandoval
blurb: Mirabel Kavanagh, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
